source: When you open the {0}Performance{/0} panel, it instantly shows your local **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)** and **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)** scores (good, needs improvement, or bad).
text: Wenn du das Panel {0}Performance{/0} öffnest, zeigt es sofort deine lokalen Werte für **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)** und **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)** an (gut, verbesserungswürdig oder schlecht).
